title: Default mass-conversion test, 5 identical single-thread runs
question: How reproducible is the test run to run (the noise floor every other comparison is read against)
observables: glucose consumed, final volume, growth rate, ledger residual
criterion: reported as the spread; later checks use it as the reference
rationale: The mass-conversion test is known not to be reproducible run to run; this measures it

title: One cell, closed 16 um box, 120 min: dx {0.5,1,2,4} x dt {0.001,0.005,0.01,0.02}, cap inactive
question: Do the outputs agree across dx and dt when the uptake cap is not limiting
observables: glucose consumed, final cell volume, growth rate (vs the finest run), ledger residual per metabolite, carbon balance
criterion: A: <=0.5% vs the plateau (dx 4, dt 0.001, where the cap cannot act); C: residual <=1e-5 of gross; D: carbon balance <=0.5%. Points with cap number R > 0.2 are cap-limited and are reported as such (dx 0.5 is kept as the failure case)
rationale: dt_mechanics = dt_phenotype = dt_diffusion = intracellular_dt (mechanics never below diffusion). At dx 0.5 a voxel (0.125 um3) is smaller than the cell (1.3 um3): the cap may act in this series; reported if so. Reference changed from the finest run to the plateau after the trial run showed the finest run (dx 0.5) is itself cap-limited (decided 2026-10-28). Criteria apply inside the safe zone (voxel >= largest cell, initial R < 0.3); dx 0.5 and 1 are boundary-of-validity runs

title: Same grid, cap active (glucose D = 0, 1 mM)
question: Does the cap act at the first step, empty the cell's voxel and never overdraw
observables: glucose never negative, voxel content at the end, total glucose fallen by V*c0
criterion: B: voxel emptied, fallen by V*c0 to 1e-3; no overdraw beyond 2*mu_max*dt*c0
rationale: Isolated voxel as an analytic case. Criteria apply inside the safe zone (voxel >= largest cell, initial R < 0.3); dx 0.5 and 1 are boundary-of-validity runs

title: 8 cells in the same 16 um box, growth and division, 120 min, same dx x dt grid, 50 mM glucose
question: Do total biomass, cell number and substrate agree across dx and dt when cells share voxels, grow and divide
observables: total biomass, cell count, remaining glucose/oxygen/acetate (vs the plateau run, at 30, 60, 90 and 120 min)
criterion: <=5% vs the plateau (dx 4, dt 0.001) in total volume and cell count at 30, 60 and 90 min
rationale: Cells are created at the origin and pushed apart by mechanics; fixed box edge so the total substrate is the same at every dx. Initial glucose 50 mM instead of the default 10 mM: in the trial the 10 mM was used up before 90 min, which voided the glucose comparison (local check with 50 mM: 26 mM left at 120 min, 32 cells). Criteria apply inside the safe zone (voxel >= largest cell, initial R < 0.3); dx 0.5 and 1 are boundary-of-validity runs

rationale: Thread-scheduling effect on a multi-cell run. Same 50 mM glucose as UT-CONV-BOX

title: Cap number: relate the deviation from the plateau to R = q*X*dt/c (X = dry biomass per voxel volume)
question: Is there a general rule linking cell size, voxel size, uptake and time step for when the uptake cap changes the dynamics
observables: deviation of volume and glucose taken vs R for DXDT-A and CONV-BOX
criterion: threshold R* where the deviation passes 0.5% (DXDT-A) / 5% (CONV-BOX)
rationale: DONE 2026-10-29 on the 70 runs: R* about 0.3 in both experiments (passes up to 0.29, fails from 0.36). R uses each run's own initial glucose. Safe zone in RESULTS.md. To be checked against the recorded cap-vs-Michaelis-Menten ratio of the use cases
